LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_ONE.title: 對話 · Dialogue
LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_ONE.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

text.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 东贤，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Dōngxián, méixiǎngdào cái liǎng nián méi jiàn, nǐ yǐjīng shì ge dà míngxīng le. Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí o, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: Dongxian, I never thought that just two years after we last saw each other, you'd already be a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
text.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
text.pinyin: Bié zhème shuō, wǒ háiyào jìxù nǔlì.
text.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
text.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ yǐjīng hěn nǔlì le. Érqiě, nǐ de Zhōngwén jìnbù de zhème kuài, shì zěnme zuò dào de?
text.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

text.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ jùběn lǐ yào shuō de bùfèn, dōu qǐng lǎoshī lù le yīn, yì yǒukòng jiù búduàn de tīng, búduàn de liànxí. Zhèyàngzi cái xué de hǎo, xué de kuài.
text.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

text.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
text.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计划？
text.pinyin: Zhè zhēnshì ge hǎo bànfǎ, nánguài nǐ jìnbù de zhème kuài. Duìle, nǐ duì wèilái yǒu shénme jìhuà?
text.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

text.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
text.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng dāng dǎoyǎn, nǎozi lǐ měitiān dōu xiǎng zhe zhè jiàn shì. Yǒu shí lián zuòmèng dōu mèngdào zìjǐ pāi diànyǐng de yàngzi, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián kāishǐ xué pāi diànyǐng.
text.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

text.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn? Nǐ zhǎng de zhème hǎokàn, shēngāo yě gòu gāo, érqiě shénme juésè dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: Director? You're so good-looking, you're tall enough, and you act well in every role; what a pity not to be an actor! Besides, audiences really appreciate your performance.

text.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
text.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
text.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn háishì kěyǐ yǎnxì de. Qíshí, yào dāng hǎo dǎoyǎn, búdàn děi dǒng zěnme pāi diànyǐng, yě yào jiāo yǎnyuán yǎnxì, tiǎozhàn gèng dà.
text.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

text.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
text.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō bùshǎo dǎoyǎn wèile bǎ diànyǐng pāi hǎo, lián jiā dōu hěn shǎo huíqù, yǒude hái yīnwèi zhèyàng líhūn le. Búguò, wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào nǐ yǒu shílì, jiù búpà tiǎozhàn le.
text.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

text.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.pinyin: Xièxie. Jīntiān néng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn liáo liáo zhēn hǎo.
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老板什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.pinyin: Nà nǐ yǐhòu bié zài gēn wǒ shuō, yīnwèi yào yǎn zǒngtǒng, shíyóu gōngsī dà lǎobǎn shénme de, méi shíjiān gēn péngyǒu jù yí jù. Bùguǎn duō máng, nǐ yě yào liú diǎnr shíjiān gěi péngyǒu a!
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.pinyin: Ēn! Duìle, yě liáo liáo nǐ zìjǐ ba. Nǐ xué de shì fǎlǜ, yǐhòu yào dāng lǜshī ba?
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒ xué fǎlǜ shì yīnwèi bàba de yāoqiú. Tā xīwàng wǒ xiān dāng lǜshī, jiānglái yǒu jīhuì dāng shàng shìzhǎng jiù gèng hǎo le.
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.pinyin: Suǒyǐ dāng shìzhǎng shì nǐ de mèngxiǎng ma?
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.pinyin: Āi, shéi xiǎng dāng shìzhǎng a? Búguò, cóngxiǎo wǒ bà mā shénme shì dōu tì wǒ ānpái hǎo le, suīrán bù xǐhuān, wǒ yě zhǐ néng rěnnài.
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒmen dōu búshì xiǎoháizi le, zìjǐ de wèilái yīnggāi zìjǐ juédìng ba.
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.pinyin: Jiùshìshuō ma! Dànshì wǒ bà mā de xiǎngfǎ tài bǎoshǒu le, yìshí hěn nán gǎibiàn tāmen.
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.pinyin: Xīwàng yǒu yì tiān, nǐ yě néng wèile zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng nǔlì.
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.pinyin: Ēn, wǒmen yìqǐ jiāyóu ba!
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_TWO.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursues His Dream

text.traditional: 現在的電影市場比以前大多了，當導演的機會也變多了，還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。其實不管在哪一個年代，要拍一部好電影，都是很大的學問。現在科技進步、資源豐富，觀眾對好電影的要求越來越高，拍戲和演戲的工作就變得更不簡單了。
text.simplified: 现在的电影市场比以前大多了，当导演的机会也变多了，还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。其实不管在哪一个年代，要拍一部好电影，都是很大的学问。现在科技进步、资源丰富，观众对好电影的要求越来越高，拍戏和演戏的工作就变得更不简单了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànyǐng shìchǎng bǐ yǐqián dà duō le, dāng dǎoyǎn de jīhuì yě biàn duō le, háiyǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Qíshí bùguǎn zài nǎ yíge niándài, yào pāi yí bù hǎo diànyǐng, dōu shì hěn dà de xuéwèn. Xiànzài kējì jìnbù, zīyuán fēngfù, guānzhòng duì hǎo diànyǐng de yāoqiú yuè lái yuè gāo, pāixì hàn yǎnxì de gōngzuò jiù biàn de gèng bù jiǎndān le.
text.english: Today's film market is much larger than before, and opportunities to become a director have also increased; there are also some directors who became very famous because they made great movies. Actually, no matter in which era, making a good movie requires great learning. Nowadays, with technological progress and abundant resources, audiences have higher and higher demands for good movies, so the work of filmmaking and acting has become even less simple.

text.traditional: 東賢從小的夢想就是當一名導演，但是有導演夢的人很多，能成功的人很少，所以父母希望他能改變主意。不過，性格開朗的東賢向他們保證，為了追求夢想，他一定會努力的。他跟父母說，要先到臺灣學習中文，還要去上表演課程，等中文學得不錯後，再學習更專業的導演技巧。而且他已經成年了，知道怎麼照顧自己，吃點苦也沒關係。爸媽聽了東賢的說明後，覺得他很勇敢、很認真，最後就答應了。
text.simplified: 东贤从小的梦想就是当一名导演，但是有导演梦的人很多，能成功的人很少，所以父母希望他能改变主意。不过，性格开朗的东贤向他们保证，为了追求梦想，他一定会努力的。他跟父母说，要先到台湾学习中文，还要去上表演课程，等中文学得不错后，再学习更专业的导演技巧。而且他已经成年了，知道怎么照顾自己，吃点苦也没关系。爸妈听了东贤的说明后，觉得他很勇敢、很认真，最后就答应了。
text.pinyin: Dōngxián cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng dǎoyǎn, dànshì yǒu dǎoyǎn mèng de rén hěn duō, néng chénggōng de rén hěn shǎo, suǒyǐ fùmǔ xīwàng tā néng gǎibiàn zhǔyì. Búguò, xìnggé kāilǎng de Dōngxián xiàng tāmen bǎozhèng, wèile zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng, tā yídìng huì nǔlì de. Tā gēn fùmǔ shuō, yào xiān dào Táiwān xuéxí Zhōngwén, háiyào qù shàng biǎoyǎn kèchéng, děng Zhōngwén xué de búcuò hòu, zài xuéxí gèng zhuānyè de dǎoyǎn jìqiǎo. Érqiě tā yǐjīng chéngnián le, zhīdào zěnme zhàogù zìjǐ, chī diǎn kǔ yě méiguānxi. Bà mā tīng le Dōngxián de shuōmíng hòu, juéde tā hěn yǒnggǎn, hěn rènzhēn, zuìhòu jiù dāyìng le.
text.english: Dongxian's dream since childhood was to become a director, but there are many people with directing dreams and very few who succeed, so his parents hoped he would change his mind. However, cheerful Dongxian promised them that he would work hard to pursue his dream. He told his parents that he would first go to Taiwan to learn Chinese, attend acting courses, and after learning Chinese well, learn more professional directing skills. Moreover, he was already an adult, knew how to take care of himself, and enduring a bit of hardship didn't matter. After listening to Dongxian's explanation, his parents felt he was very brave and earnest, and finally agreed.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣以後，東賢很快就適應了新的生活，也找到了一份模特兒的工作。這樣不但有錢付生活費，還能讓表演經驗更豐富。這種為了夢想，每天很早出門、很晚回家的生活，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心、很滿足。因為對他來說，夢想就像一張美麗的圖，一開始只是一張白紙，想追求夢想的人就得自己設計、配上顏色，最後才能完成一張好圖。他相信只要自己肯努力，最後一定能夢想成真的。
text.simplified: 到了台湾以后，东贤很快就适应了新的生活，也找到了一份模特儿的工作。这样不但有钱付生活费，还能让表演经验更丰富。这种为了梦想，每天很早出门、很晚回家的生活，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心、很满足。因为对他来说，梦想就像一张美丽的图，一开始只是一张白纸，想追求梦想的人就得自己设计、配上颜色，最后才能完成一张好图。他相信只要自己肯努力，最后一定能梦想成真的。
text.pinyin: Dào le Táiwān yǐhòu, Dōngxián hěn kuài jiù shìyìng le xīn de shēnghuó, yě zhǎodào le yí fèn mótèr de gōngzuò. Zhèyàng búdàn yǒu qián fù shēnghuó fèi, hái néng ràng biǎoyǎn jīngyàn gèng fēngfù. Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng, měitiān hěn zǎo chūmén, hěn wǎn huíjiā de shēnghuó, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn, hěn mǎnzú. Yīnwèi duì tā lái shuō, mèngxiǎng jiù xiàng yì zhāng měilì de tú, yìkāishǐ zhǐshì yì zhāng bái zhǐ, xiǎng zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de rén jiù děi zìjǐ shèjì, pèi shàng yánsè, zuìhòu cái néng wánchéng yì zhāng hǎo tú. Tā xiāngxìn zhǐyào zìjǐ kěn nǔlì, zuìhòu yídìng néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de.
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian quickly adapted to his new life and also found a job as a model. This not only provided money to pay living expenses, but also enriched his acting experience. For this kind of life of leaving early and returning late every day for his dream, even if he was exceedingly tired, Dongxian still felt very happy and satisfied. Because to him, a dream is like a beautiful picture: in the beginning it is only a blank sheet of paper, and a person who wants to pursue a dream must design it himself and add colors, and only then can he complete a good picture. He believes that as long as he is willing to work hard, his dream will surely come true in the end.

LESSON_ONE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–3 · My Dream

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain or clarify something already stated using 可以說是.
grammarPages.explanation: 用來進一步說明前面的說話內容。「可以說是」和「可說是」的意思一樣。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 可以說是 / 可說是 + Noun / Description

patternRows.english: You could say I am your fan.
You could say he is an adult now.
You could call this my second home.

text.traditional: 你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí o, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: I've watched all your dramas; you could say I'm your fan—please sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 他下個月就滿十八歲了，可以說是一個大人了。
text.simplified: 他下个月就满十八岁了，可以说是一个大人了。
text.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè jiù mǎn shíbā suì le, kěyǐ shuō shì yíge dàrén le.
text.english: He turns eighteen next month; you could say he's an adult.

text.traditional: 我在高雄住了十年了，這裡可說是我第二個家。
text.simplified: 我在高雄住了十年了，这里可说是我第二个家。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Gāoxióng zhù le shí nián le, zhèlǐ kě shuō shì wǒ dì'èr ge jiā.
text.english: I've lived in Kaohsiung for ten years; you could call it my second home.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 可以說是 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This phrase is used to further explain or clarify something already stated. 可以說是 and 可說是 have the same meaning.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Exclaim that something is more … than you expected, using 多（麼）… 啊.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示感嘆的意思，說明事情比本來想的程度高。表達時帶有誇張的語氣，「麼」可以省略，結尾以「啊」結束。

patternRows.english: What a pity not to become an actor!

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高……不當演員多麼可惜啊！
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看，身高也够高……不当演员多么可惜啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎngde zhème hǎokàn, shēngāo yě gòu gāo… bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a!
text.english: You are so good-looking and tall enough…what a pity it would be not to become an actor!

text.traditional: 那隻狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵長長的，多可愛啊！
text.simplified: 那只狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵长长的，多可爱啊！
text.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu de yǎnjīng dà dà de, ěrduo cháng cháng de, duō kě'ài a!
text.english: That dog's eyes are big and its ears are long; how cute!

text.traditional: 外面熱死了，我在家邊看電視邊吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.simplified: 外面热死了，我在家边看电视边吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn rè sǐ le, wǒ zài jiā biān kàn diànshì biān chī mángguǒ bīng, duō shūfu a!
text.english: It's terribly hot outside; how comfortable it is to watch TV and eat mango ice at home!

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 多麼…啊 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This construction indicates a feeling when one encounters something exceeding one's expectations. Expressed in an exaggerated tone of voice, the 麼 can be dropped, and an 啊 added to the end of the sentence, usually following an adjective.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add an additional reason or explanation using 再說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「再說」當連詞。「再說」後面的句子是對前面句子所說的內容，補充、說明或提供進一步的解釋。

patternRows.english: You look good; besides, audiences approve of your performance.
I have to hand in two reports; besides, finals are coming up.
You make many friends; besides, you understand yourself better.

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看……不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看……不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎngde zhème hǎokàn… bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: You are so good-looking…what a pity not to become an actor! Besides, the audience really approves of your performance.

text.traditional: 最近得交兩個報告，再說，快期末考了，下星期的旅遊我不去了。
text.simplified: 最近得交两个报告，再说，快期末考了，下星期的旅游我不去了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn děi jiāo liǎng ge bàogào, zàishuō, kuài qímòkǎo le, xià xīngqí de lǚyóu wǒ bú qù le.
text.english: I have to hand in two reports soon; besides, finals are coming up. I'm not going on next week's trip.

text.traditional: 參加社團活動能交到不少朋友，再說，還能讓我們更了解自己，你為什麼不參加呢？
text.simplified: 参加社团活动能交到不少朋友，再说，还能让我们更了解自己，你为什么不参加呢？
text.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng néng jiāo dào bùshǎo péngyǒu, zàishuō, hái néng ràng wǒmen gèng liǎojiě zìjǐ, nǐ wèishénme bù cānjiā ne?
text.english: Joining club activities lets us make quite a few friends; besides, it helps us understand ourselves better. Why don't you join?

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 再說 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 再說 is used as a conjunction. The sentence following 再說 reinforces the content of the preceding sentence, or explains that content in greater detail.

dialogue.title: 對話 · Dialogue
dialogue.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

text.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 东贤，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Dōngxián, méixiǎngdào cái liǎng nián méi jiàn, nǐ yǐjīng shì ge dà míngxīng le. Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí o, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: Dongxian, I never thought that just two years after we last saw each other, you'd already be a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
text.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
text.pinyin: Bié zhème shuō, wǒ háiyào jìxù nǔlì.
text.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
text.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ yǐjīng hěn nǔlì le. Érqiě, nǐ de Zhōngwén jìnbù de zhème kuài, shì zěnme zuò dào de?
text.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

text.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ jùběn lǐ yào shuō de bùfèn, dōu qǐng lǎoshī lù le yīn, yì yǒukòng jiù búduàn de tīng, búduàn de liànxí. Zhèyàngzi cái xué de hǎo, xué de kuài.
text.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

text.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
text.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计划？
text.pinyin: Zhè zhēnshì ge hǎo bànfǎ, nánguài nǐ jìnbù de zhème kuài. Duìle, nǐ duì wèilái yǒu shénme jìhuà?
text.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

text.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
text.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng dāng dǎoyǎn, nǎozi lǐ měitiān dōu xiǎng zhe zhè jiàn shì. Yǒu shí lián zuòmèng dōu mèngdào zìjǐ pāi diànyǐng de yàngzi, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián kāishǐ xué pāi diànyǐng.
text.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

text.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn? Nǐ zhǎng de zhème hǎokàn, shēngāo yě gòu gāo, érqiě shénme juésè dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: Director? You're so good-looking, you're tall enough, and you act well in every role; what a pity not to be an actor! Besides, audiences really appreciate your performance.

text.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
text.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
text.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn háishì kěyǐ yǎnxì de. Qíshí, yào dāng hǎo dǎoyǎn, búdàn děi dǒng zěnme pāi diànyǐng, yě yào jiāo yǎnyuán yǎnxì, tiǎozhàn gèng dà.
text.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

text.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
text.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō bùshǎo dǎoyǎn wèile bǎ diànyǐng pāi hǎo, lián jiā dōu hěn shǎo huíqù, yǒude hái yīnwèi zhèyàng líhūn le. Búguò, wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào nǐ yǒu shílì, jiù búpà tiǎozhàn le.
text.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

text.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.pinyin: Xièxie. Jīntiān néng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn liáo liáo zhēn hǎo.
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老板什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.pinyin: Nà nǐ yǐhòu bié zài gēn wǒ shuō, yīnwèi yào yǎn zǒngtǒng, shíyóu gōngsī dà lǎobǎn shénme de, méi shíjiān gēn péngyǒu jù yí jù. Bùguǎn duō máng, nǐ yě yào liú diǎnr shíjiān gěi péngyǒu a!
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.pinyin: Ēn! Duìle, yě liáo liáo nǐ zìjǐ ba. Nǐ xué de shì fǎlǜ, yǐhòu yào dāng lǜshī ba?
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒ xué fǎlǜ shì yīnwèi bàba de yāoqiú. Tā xīwàng wǒ xiān dāng lǜshī, jiānglái yǒu jīhuì dāng shàng shìzhǎng jiù gèng hǎo le.
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.pinyin: Suǒyǐ dāng shìzhǎng shì nǐ de mèngxiǎng ma?
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.pinyin: Āi, shéi xiǎng dāng shìzhǎng a? Búguò, cóngxiǎo wǒ bà mā shénme shì dōu tì wǒ ānpái hǎo le, suīrán bù xǐhuān, wǒ yě zhǐ néng rěnnài.
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒmen dōu búshì xiǎoháizi le, zìjǐ de wèilái yīnggāi zìjǐ juédìng ba.
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.pinyin: Jiùshìshuō ma! Dànshì wǒ bà mā de xiǎngfǎ tài bǎoshǒu le, yìshí hěn nán gǎibiàn tāmen.
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.pinyin: Xīwàng yǒu yì tiān, nǐ yě néng wèile zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng nǔlì.
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.pinyin: Ēn, wǒmen yìqǐ jiāyóu ba!
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

LESSON_ONE_PART_ONE.completionDescription: Great progress! You completed the first part of this lesson.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: State a cause and its result, in formal or written Chinese, using 因為……（，）而…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「而」當連詞，「因為」的後面是事情的原因，「而」的後面是事情的結果。常用在書面或正式場合。「因為……（，）而……」有「因為……所以……」的意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 因為 + Cause（，）+ 而 + Result

patternRows.english: Some directors became very famous because they made good films.
He moved to the countryside because he could not adjust to city life.
He lost his job because he drove after drinking.

text.traditional: ……還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。
text.simplified: ……还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。
text.pinyin: …Háiyǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng.
text.english: …Some directors have also become famous because they made good films.

text.traditional: 他因為不適應都市緊張的生活，而搬到了鄉下，過著自由、簡單的日子。
text.simplified: 他因为不适应都市紧张的生活，而搬到了乡下，过着自由、简单的日子。
text.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi bú shìyìng dūshì jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó, ér bān dào le xiāngxià, guò zhe zìyóu, jiǎndān de rìzi.
text.english: Because he could not adapt to the stress of city life, he moved to the countryside, where he lives a free and simple life.

text.traditional: 大家約他吃飯喝酒，慶祝他找到工作，沒想到他因為喝酒開車而丟了工作。
text.simplified: 大家约他吃饭喝酒，庆祝他找到工作，没想到他因为喝酒开车而丢了工作。
text.pinyin: Dàjiā yuē tā chīfàn hē jiǔ, qìngzhù tā zhǎodào gōngzuò, méixiǎngdào tā yīnwèi hē jiǔ kāichē ér diū le gōngzuò.
text.english: Everyone invited him out for dinner and drinks to celebrate his new job, but no one expected him to lose that job because he drove after drinking.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 而 is a conjunction, 因為 is followed by the cause, and 而 is followed by the result of the matter. Commonly used in written or formal occasions. 因為……（，）而……means 因為……所以…….

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that an action creates something new, such as a film, a novel or an idea, using V 出 O.
grammarPages.explanation: 動詞後面加「出」可表示動作從裡到外的方向，例如：我從書包裡拿出鉛筆。本課動詞後面加「出」，表示動作完成後，產生新事物。常用的動詞有：想、做、說、穿、拍、寫、找、算、研究等等。

patternRows.english: I can't make a cake I'm happy with.

text.traditional: ……還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。
text.simplified: ……还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。
text.pinyin: …Háiyǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng.
text.english: …Some directors have also become famous because they made good films.

text.traditional: 他花了三年的時間，最後寫出了一本大家都非常喜愛的小說。
text.simplified: 他花了三年的时间，最后写出了一本大家都非常喜爱的小说。
text.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián de shíjiān, zuìhòu xiě chū le yì běn dàjiā dōu fēicháng xǐ'ài de xiǎoshuō.
text.english: He spent three years and finally wrote a novel that everyone loves.

text.traditional: 我學做蛋糕學了很久，還是做不出讓自己滿意的蛋糕。
text.simplified: 我学做蛋糕学了很久，还是做不出让自己满意的蛋糕。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xué zuò dàngāo xué le hěn jiǔ, háishì zuò bù chū ràng zìjǐ mǎnyì de dàngāo.
text.english: I've been learning to make cakes for a long time, but I still can't make one I'm happy with.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Add 出 after the verb to indicate that the direction of the action is from the inside to the outside. For example, 我從書包裡拿出鉛筆. In this lesson, adding 出 after the verb means that new things will be generated after the action is completed. Commonly used verbs are: 想, 做, 說, 穿, 拍, 寫, 找, 算, 研究, etc.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that even if something happened, a fact or decision would stay the same, using 就算……（，）也…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「就算」當連詞，後面是一個假設，表示不會因為這個假設的情況，而改變原來的事實或決定。例如：A：今天下雨，我不去學校了。B：不行，就算下雪，也得去學校。
grammarPages.pattern: 就算 + Condition (，) + 也 + Result / Action

patternRows.english: Even if extremely tired, Dongxian still feels very happy.
Even working twelve hours would be no problem.
Even without eating or drinking for twenty years, I still could not afford it.

text.traditional: 這種為了夢想……，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心、很滿足。
text.simplified: 这种为了梦想……，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心、很满足。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng…, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn, hěn mǎnzú.
text.english: This kind of life for a dream… even if he is extremely tired, Dongxian still feels very happy and satisfied.

text.traditional: 方小姐想多存一點兒錢，就算一天工作十二個小時也沒問題。
text.simplified: 方小姐想多存一点儿钱，就算一天工作十二个小时也没问题。
text.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě xiǎng duō cún yìdiǎnr qián, jiùsuàn yì tiān gōngzuò shí'èr ge xiǎoshí yě méi wèntí.
text.english: Miss Fang wants to save a little more money; even working twelve hours a day is no problem.

text.traditional: 我覺得那個地區房子的價格都太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也買不起。
text.simplified: 我觉得那个地区房子的价格都太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也买不起。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nàge dìqū fángzi de jiàgé dōu tài gāo le, jiùsuàn èrshí nián bù chī bù hē yě mǎi bù qǐ.
text.english: I think the homes in that area are all too expensive; even without eating or drinking for twenty years, I couldn't afford one.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 就算……也…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 就算 is a conjunction, followed by a hypothesis, which means that the original situation will not be changed because of the content of this hypothesis. For example, A：今天下雨，我不去學校了。B：不行，就算下雪，也得去學校。

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursuing His Dream

text.traditional: 現在的電影市場比以前大多了，當導演的機會也變多了，還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。其實不管在哪一個年代，要拍一部好電影，都是很大的學問。現在科技進步、資源豐富，觀眾對好電影的要求越來越高，拍戲和演戲的工作就變得更不簡單了。
text.simplified: 现在的电影市场比以前大多了，当导演的机会也变多了，还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。其实不管在哪一个年代，要拍一部好电影，都是很大的学问。现在科技进步、资源丰富，观众对好电影的要求越来越高，拍戏和演戏的工作就变得更不简单了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànyǐng shìchǎng bǐ yǐqián dà duō le, dāng dǎoyǎn de jīhuì yě biàn duō le, háiyǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Qíshí bùguǎn zài nǎ yíge niándài, yào pāi yí bù hǎo diànyǐng, dōu shì hěn dà de xuéwèn. Xiànzài kējì jìnbù, zīyuán fēngfù, guānzhòng duì hǎo diànyǐng de yāoqiú yuè lái yuè gāo, pāixì hàn yǎnxì de gōngzuò jiù biàn de gèng bù jiǎndān le.
text.english: Today's film market is much larger than before, and opportunities to become a director have also increased; there are also some directors who became very famous because they made great movies. Actually, no matter in which era, making a good movie requires great learning. Nowadays, with technological progress and abundant resources, audiences have higher and higher demands for good movies, so the work of filmmaking and acting has become even less simple.

text.traditional: 東賢從小的夢想就是當一名導演，但是有導演夢的人很多，能成功的人很少，所以父母希望他能改變主意。不過，性格開朗的東賢向他們保證，為了追求夢想，他一定會努力的。他跟父母說，要先到臺灣學習中文，還要去上表演課程，等中文學得不錯後，再學習更專業的導演技巧。而且他已經成年了，知道怎麼照顧自己，吃點苦也沒關係。爸媽聽了東賢的說明後，覺得他很勇敢、很認真，最後就答應了。
text.simplified: 东贤从小的梦想就是当一名导演，但是有导演梦的人很多，能成功的人很少，所以父母希望他能改变主意。不过，性格开朗的东贤向他们保证，为了追求梦想，他一定会努力的。他跟父母说，要先到台湾学习中文，还要去上表演课程，等中文学得不错后，再学习更专业的导演技巧。而且他已经成年了，知道怎么照顾自己，吃点苦也没关系。爸妈听了东贤的说明后，觉得他很勇敢、很认真，最后就答应了。
text.pinyin: Dōngxián cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng dǎoyǎn, dànshì yǒu dǎoyǎn mèng de rén hěn duō, néng chénggōng de rén hěn shǎo, suǒyǐ fùmǔ xīwàng tā néng gǎibiàn zhǔyì. Búguò, xìnggé kāilǎng de Dōngxián xiàng tāmen bǎozhèng, wèile zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng, tā yídìng huì nǔlì de. Tā gēn fùmǔ shuō, yào xiān dào Táiwān xuéxí Zhōngwén, háiyào qù shàng biǎoyǎn kèchéng, děng Zhōngwén xué de búcuò hòu, zài xuéxí gèng zhuānyè de dǎoyǎn jìqiǎo. Érqiě tā yǐjīng chéngnián le, zhīdào zěnme zhàogù zìjǐ, chī diǎn kǔ yě méiguānxi. Bà mā tīng le Dōngxián de shuōmíng hòu, juéde tā hěn yǒnggǎn, hěn rènzhēn, zuìhòu jiù dāyìng le.
text.english: Dongxian's dream since childhood was to become a director, but there are many people with directing dreams and very few who succeed, so his parents hoped he would change his mind. However, cheerful Dongxian promised them that he would work hard to pursue his dream. He told his parents that he would first go to Taiwan to learn Chinese, attend acting courses, and after learning Chinese well, learn more professional directing skills. Moreover, he was already an adult, knew how to take care of himself, and enduring a bit of hardship didn't matter. After listening to Dongxian's explanation, his parents felt he was very brave and earnest, and finally agreed.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣以後，東賢很快就適應了新的生活，也找到了一份模特兒的工作。這樣不但有錢付生活費，還能讓表演經驗更豐富。這種為了夢想，每天很早出門、很晚回家的生活，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心、很滿足。因為對他來說，夢想就像一張美麗的圖，一開始只是一張白紙，想追求夢想的人就得自己設計、配上顏色，最後才能完成一張好圖。他相信只要自己肯努力，最後一定能夢想成真的。
text.simplified: 到了台湾以后，东贤很快就适应了新的生活，也找到了一份模特儿的工作。这样不但有钱付生活费，还能让表演经验更丰富。这种为了梦想，每天很早出门、很晚回家的生活，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心、很满足。因为对他来说，梦想就像一张美丽的图，一开始只是一张白纸，想追求梦想的人就得自己设计、配上颜色，最后才能完成一张好图。他相信只要自己肯努力，最后一定能梦想成真的。
text.pinyin: Dào le Táiwān yǐhòu, Dōngxián hěn kuài jiù shìyìng le xīn de shēnghuó, yě zhǎodào le yí fèn mótèr de gōngzuò. Zhèyàng búdàn yǒu qián fù shēnghuó fèi, hái néng ràng biǎoyǎn jīngyàn gèng fēngfù. Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng, měitiān hěn zǎo chūmén, hěn wǎn huíjiā de shēnghuó, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn, hěn mǎnzú. Yīnwèi duì tā lái shuō, mèngxiǎng jiù xiàng yì zhāng měilì de tú, yìkāishǐ zhǐshì yì zhāng bái zhǐ, xiǎng zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de rén jiù děi zìjǐ shèjì, pèi shàng yánsè, zuìhòu cái néng wánchéng yì zhāng hǎo tú. Tā xiāngxìn zhǐyào zìjǐ kěn nǔlì, zuìhòu yídìng néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de.
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian quickly adapted to his new life and also found a job as a model. This not only provided money to pay living expenses, but also enriched his acting experience. For this kind of life of leaving early and returning late every day for his dream, even if he was exceedingly tired, Dongxian still felt very happy and satisfied. Because to him, a dream is like a beautiful picture: in the beginning it is only a blank sheet of paper, and a person who wants to pursue a dream must design it himself and add colors, and only then can he complete a good picture. He believes that as long as he is willing to work hard, his dream will surely come true in the end.
